supportedAverageHousehold.combinedTotalNote: Built from the 2026 Tax Rates RT row applied to the County's published median assessment ($391,000). Municipal + hospital = $4,295.33, matching the approved budget's illustrated residential impact $4,295.35 (which excludes education). Full bill including education is $4,893.56.
warnings: County budget illustrations of $4,295.35 exclude education; this receipt shows the full RT total.
Rate × $391,000 yields $4,295.33 for municipal+hospital; the budget table prints $4,295.35 (2¢).
Department shares are a pro-rata model over the net levy — not a published per-household split.
Paris is billed as County of Brant (single-tier FIR 2920); there is no separate Town of Paris pack.
